It is reported that Paramount Pictures will cooperate with well-known producer Lorenzo di Bonaventura to develop the film. CD Projekt RED co-CEO Michał Nowakovsky said on social media: "We are delighted to be working with Paramount, who are highly aligned with our creative ambitions." He added that the team looks forward to announcing more details when the time is right. As of July 3, "Cyberpunk 2077" has sold 40 million copies, and the expansion pack "Shadows of the Past" has sold 15 million copies. At the same time, more than 184 developers are actively developing the sequel to "Cyberpunk 2077".

en.title: Why is the Strawberry Music Festival doing a game show?
en.summary: Queuing up to try out games, receive peripherals, and collect stamps for lottery draws. In this rectangular space of nearly 100 square meters, many "players" are just like attending an ordinary game exhibition, curiously looking for their favorite games. If it weren't for the live music and audience cheers that kept coming from the distance, it would be difficult for me to realize that this was just a part of this music festival, not a game show or comic show in a certain convention center. It's not unusual to have a musical performance during a game show. Because game concerts are already a relatively mature business form. But if on the other hand, holding a game exhibition in a music festival would feel a bit fresh - especially when the organizer is a "new face" in the game industry: Modern Sky and Strawberry Music Festival. At the Guangzhou Strawberry Music Festival that ended at the end of September, Game House, a subsidiary of Modern Sky, teamed up with Haoyu Kuaibao to set up a game exhibition area at the festival. Audiences can try out games including "The Fog" on site

en.title: Chule Night Talk: Buying the future of the gaming industry
en.summary: He is very fond of weird things, and talks about nonsense, ghost things, and new things related to games every day. Picture / Ronaldinho I suddenly discovered that there are still a lot of EA (early access version) games in my Steam game library. Part of the reason is that I'm used to Steam's "early access" mode. When I encounter a game that I am interested in, I often rush to buy it into my library because I am afraid that I will never encounter it again. Most of the time, these games always look vibrant and don't cost too much. The production team always lists a long update plan, which makes people feel very reassured just by seeing it. At the same time, there are also some games that I have put into the library many years ago and are still in the EA stage. They have been repeatedly polished and even torn down and started over. items.title: 十多年后，刀光依旧：《胧村正怪奇谭》试玩小结
items.summary: 在如今这个动作游戏越来越强调连招、取消、派生与各种复杂系统的时代，再回头看看香草社的代表作品之一《胧村正》，反而会觉得它的设计有些“平淡”。从今天的眼光去分析，这似乎就是一款披着日本传统美术外衣、以妖怪和神话为题材的横版动作游戏。可最奇怪的地方也正在这里——时隔这么多年，当我玩到了《胧村正怪奇谭》时，才发现这样一款看起来并不复杂的游戏，到了今天，依然有种让我一玩就停不下来的魔力。 与其说本作是《胧村正》的高清化，不如说开发组更像是在整理一件保存了十多年的旧物——在保留了原作最重要的战斗、美术与内容下，针对今天的硬件与玩家习惯进行适当调整，让这段已经有些遥远的游戏记忆，以新的面貌重新回到玩家面前

ja.title: 十数年を経た今も、その剣は輝く――『装咲村正奇譚』裁判概要
ja.summary: アクションゲームにおいてコンボやキャンセル、派生、そして様々な複雑なシステムが重視されるようになった現代において、バニラクラブの代表作のひとつである『装甲悪鬼村正』を改めて振り返ってみると、そのデザインは少々「味気ない」と感じるだろう。今日の視点から見ると、これは日本の伝統的な芸術に包まれ、モンスターや神話に基づいた横スクロール アクション ゲームのように見えます。しかし、最も奇妙なのはここにあります。何年も経った後、「飫肥村正奇譚」をプレイしたとき、この一見単純なゲームがまだプレイをやめられない不思議な力を持っていることに気づきました。本作は、『飫肥村正』の高画質版というよりは、10年以上保存されていた古いものを開発チームが整理しているような感覚で、オリジナルゲームの最も重要な戦闘やアート、内容はそのままに、今日のハードウェアやプレイヤーの習慣に合わせて適切に調整し、少し遠いゲームの記憶を新たな姿でプレイヤーの手に取り戻している。

en.title: More than ten years later, the sword still shines: Summary of the trial of "The Strange Tales of Misaki Muramasa"
en.summary: In today's era where action games increasingly emphasize combos, cancellations, derivation, and various complex systems, if you look back at "Hazy Muramasa", one of Vanilla Club's representative works, you will feel that its design is a bit "bland". From today's perspective, this seems to be a side-scrolling action game wrapped in traditional Japanese art and based on monsters and mythology. But the strangest thing is here - after so many years, when I played "Obi Muramasa's Strange Tales", I discovered that such a seemingly uncomplicated game still has a magical power that makes me unable to stop playing it. Rather than saying that this game is a high-definition version of "Obi Muramasa", it is more like the development team is sorting out an old thing that has been preserved for more than ten years - while retaining the most important combat, art and content of the original game, it makes appropriate adjustments to today's hardware and player habits, allowing this somewhat distant game memory to return to players with a new look.

ja.summary: 今年9月、北京で『シャドウブレード ゼロ』のオフライン体験会が開催された。私も幸運にも、プレイヤーの期待を集めるこの「カンフーパンク」の傑作をいち早く垣間見ることができました。武道をテーマにしたテンポの速いアクション ゲームであるこのゲームは、音楽の面でも独特の体験を私にもたらしてくれました。これらは当然ながら、一連のゲームの音楽ディレクターであり、私たちのマシンコアの古い友人である Bo Caisheng のおかげです。 18 年前のインディーズ ゲーム「Rainblood」から、その後の「Shadow Blade」シリーズ、そして今日の AAA レベルの「Shadow Blade Zero」に至るまで、Bo Caisheng の音楽は常にこのシリーズの重要な部分を占めてきました。この貴重な機会を利用して、私たちは幸運にもボー・カイシェン氏に再びインタビューすることができました。プロデューサーのリャン・チーウェイ（S）との10年以上の協力から始まり、今回の3Aレベルの制作に直面する際に音楽デザインがもたらす課題、そしてプレイヤーが最も懸念していること、つまりゲーム音楽で大成功を待つものについて話しました。

From the independent game "Rainblood" 18 years ago, to the later "Shadow Blade" series, to today's AAA-level "Shadow Blade Zero", Bo Caisheng's music has always been an important part of this series. en.title: Preview of "Shadow Blade Zero": A quite complete journey of exploration and combat
en.summary: On September 3, Chule participated in the closed offline trial session of "Shadow Blade Zero" at the invitation of Lingyoufang. The important thing about this demo is that the version available at the event is arguably not that different from the version that will be released soon. During the approximately 5 hours of trial play, we had a relatively complete experience of the story opening, plot CG, level design and boss battles, and even details such as controller feedback. The process covered the entire first chapter of the big map, hidden maps, hidden bosses, a small amount of the second chapter content and two later bosses. If the previous demos released sporadically by Lingyoufang still gave people a feeling of peeking into the background, this time the demos make people feel quite reassured about the overall quality of the game. In terms of exploration and combat experience, "Shadow Blade Zero" maintains a consistently high level; in particular, games in the past have shown less in terms of levels and development, and this time it also brought us the biggest surprise. The newly encountered bosses each have their own characteristics.

en.title: Chongqing’s gaming industry faces a turning point

At that time, he planned to recruit a group of people in his hometown, set up a team, and return to the United States to provide remote support and develop high-quality stand-alone game products. en.title: What was the earliest human civilization like?
en.summary: Although humans have been building civilizations since ancient times, very few records remain from the ancient times. Kurzgesagt, a science-based YouTube channel, traces the history of humanity since the end of the last ice age, about 12,000 years ago. read more...
